summary: Constructs the file path to terrain.ini by formatting the season and track directory globals into a caller-supplied buffer via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck. Each directory global falls back to the default application directory (byte_5EA438) when null. Called from scene/particle/telemetry initialization paths.

operations.description: v2 = dword_5EC420 (track directory); when null, v2 = byte_5EA438 (default application directory).
Null guard on the track directory global dword_5EC420; if zero, substitute the default directory byte_5EA438.
v3 = dword_5EC3D8 (season directory); when null, v3 = byte_5EA438 (default application directory).
Null guard on the season directory global dword_5EC3D8; if zero, substitute the default directory byte_5EA438.

Call StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(a1, "%s%sterrain.ini", v3, v2) formatting the two directory paths plus the terrain.ini literal (aSSterrainIni at 0x005D3930) into the caller-supplied target buffer a1.
Return the result of the formatting call to the caller.

Invoked by SceneTrackFileLoader (0044C0E0), ParticleSoundEffectSpawner (004607A0), SpecialFX_Init (004CF070) and TelemetryDataDump (004D4A80) to obtain the terrain.ini path during track/effect/telemetry setup.

unresolved: a1 and a2 roles: a1 is the target buffer of the format call; a2 is unused in the raw source and its purpose is unknown.
The exact meaning of the season/track directory globals (dword_5EC3D8, dword_5EC420) and of byte_5EA438 (assumed default application directory) is DERIVED from call context, not proven here.
